Query:
UNLOAD (SELECT bs."in.nhgis_tract_gisjoin" AS nhgis_tract_gisjoin, sum(1) AS sample_count, sum(bs.weight) AS units_count, sum(bs."out.electricity.total.energy_consumption..kwh" * bs.weight) AS "electricity.total.energy_consumption..kwh" FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs WHERE bs.applicability = true AND bs.upgrade = 0 AND (bs.bldg_id, bs."in.nhgis_tract_gisjoin", bs.state) IN (SELECT bs.bldg_id, bs."in.nhgis_tract_gisjoin", bs.state FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs WHERE bs.upgrade IN (1) AND bs.applicability = true GROUP BY bs.bldg_id, bs."in.nhgis_tract_gisjoin", bs.state HAVING count(distinct(bs.upgrade)) = 1) AND bs.state = 'CO' AND bs.bldg_id IN (46369, 46370, 46381, 46382, 46803, 46813, 46897, 46898) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) 
 TO 's3://resstock-core/bsq_athena_unload_results/b4a688f064c133901259633d934dc1fee61d697ce10d88f2a151a4fe20f8405f/3f6d39ba-8c19-4f6b-ae25-7c532059b794/'
